players.product: NULISA precision-proteomics assays and ARGO HT System

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus: 2025 revenue was $74,211 thousand versus $25,142 thousand in 2024 (+195%): instruments $21,621 thousand (+148%), consumables $36,818 thousand (+382%) and services $15,272 thousand (+74%); gross profit was $41,705 thousand (2024: $8,607 thousand). Preliminary estimated Q1 2026 revenue was $25,200 thousand to $26,200 thousand versus $13,091 thousand in Q1 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue $74,211 thousand (+195%); consumables +382%; Q1 2026 preliminary revenue $25,200 thousand to $26,200 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier GENER8 LLC (contract manufacturer): Alamar outsources the manufacture and supply of its ARGO HT instrument to GENER8 under a Second Amended and Restated Commercial Supply Agreement dated July 29, 2025, purchasing on a forecast and ordering mechanism at a price set in the agreement; GENER8 must use commercially reasonable efforts to reduce product cost and share the benefit through price reductions, and has represented that it maintains ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 certifications. A second contract manufacturer with ISO 13485 certification develops and produces the prototype ARGO HT/DX system. All consumable kit products are manufactured in-house at Alamar's Fremont, California facilities, and the company has qualified second sources for most, but not all, critical components and reagents.

Supplier Abcam Inc.: under a Research Use Only Affinity Reagent Supply Agreement entered in September 2021 and amended in August 2023 and December 2025, Abcam supplies certain antibody-based affinity reagents on a forecast and ordering mechanism and grants Alamar a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-bearing licence; Alamar pays a mid-single digit running royalty on net sales of products and services that contain or consume the Abcam reagents, and licenses the majority of its antibodies and antigens from Abcam. Separately, the prospectus says Alamar depends on a single-source supplier for a majority of the antibodies used in its NULISA assay, with lead times of several months or more for some antibodies and instruments.
